quality_authority: explicit human feedback on exact output versions

confirmed_preferences.feedback: approve or reject one output with comments
confirmed_preferences.directional_choices: A/B only for substantially different directional decisions
confirmed_preferences.open_model_serving: quality models at a good price through an API inference provider
confirmed_preferences.basis: explicit user instructions in the 2026-10-10 review

selection_order: quality-approved hosted open model or explicitly approved other model/API
human decision when no approved route meets quality or access constraints
optimization_order: factual identity provenance and release eligibility
usage cost latency and human revision effort

current_reference.basis: saved local configuration observed 2026-10-10; not proof of historical output attribution

subscription_policy.on_limit: preserve work and ask about waiting or an already approved route; no automatic purchases or resets

role_policy.discovery: subscription-assisted bounded search; retrieval is separate from model inference
role_policy.event_research: subscription synthesis with source locators and explicit conflicts
role_policy.catalog: deterministic catalog plus observed interval review; vision models require separate evaluation
role_policy.typed_judgments: Explicit advisory Jev calls through OpenRouter; typed findings feed bounded story jobs and human review, never automatic acceptance
role_policy.story_editor: subscription reference plus human brief and user review of important narrative choices
role_policy.assembly: deterministic render with reviewed script; voice changes require listening feedback
role_policy.qa: independent evidence review and technical checks; model scores do not imply human acceptance
role_policy.release: local release contracts remain implemented; hash-bound human acceptance is a separate explicitly recorded milestone

efficiency_candidates.hard_task_escalation: gpt-6-astra when available and justified by quality difficulty
efficiency_candidates.promotion: held-out evidence and explicit human approval; candidate names are not quality rankings
efficiency_candidates.report: all attempts, failures, escalation, cost/usage where measured, time to human acceptance and revision effort

human_checkpoints: important audience tone length depth and format preferences
story angle and major script changes
finished output acceptance or revision feedback
production model promotion and durable preference changes
new paid or external data-processing scope unless already authorized

feedback_policy.default_comparison: approve or reject one output with comments
feedback_policy.ab_comparison: only for substantially different directional decisions
feedback_policy.bind_to: exact event, manifest, video/output hashes, model receipts and preference version
feedback_policy.retain: verbatim human feedback with interpretation and scope separate; corrections are append-only

open_model_goal.serving: hosted API inference; no local model installation target
promotion_requires: verified license, exact provider/model/endpoint/settings and exposed serving revision/quantization; unavailable hosted weight hashes stay unknown
human approval with no regression in required preferences
measured API cost/latency/reliability and full workflow/tool capability
open_model_goal.complete_when: every required inference capability uses a human-approved open model without a closed-model fallback
open_model_goal.openness_definition: permissively licensed open weights/code hosted by an inference API; do not claim complete training-source openness
open_model_goal.selection_basis: explicit user instruction; candidate route, not quality promotion
open_model_goal.adapter_scope: bounded text; vision, transcription and narration require separate adapters and human evaluation
